header: WHAT THE SEARCH LINE NEEDS TO KNOW ABOUT THIS TOPIC (pure, no React): the words of the Durgapur Railway Station card ("durgapur railway station trains"). The data, its source and its checks are in src/lib/live/railway.ts; how it looks is in RailwayCard.tsx and ui.tsx. It is listed once, in src/tools/registry.ts. My rule: a line is this card's when it has a key word and every word is a key word, an extra word or a filler. "trains" alone opens it, "train ticket booking" does not (it has words that are not the card's).
